content:
Even though we are dealing with lots at our house right now I am using my husband's nap times to quietly write get out the vote postcards.
Today I wrote a hundred cards for Arizona.
Still another hundred to go but there is always tomorrow.
Iowa postcards are on their way to me.
Postcards and five phone calls are what I can do right now.
Summer and I also sent a donation of dog and cat food to three local animal rescue organizations. We decided that good and reliable animal shelters here in Humboldt probably need our help right now.
We picked Redwood Pal's Rescue, Animal Companion Foundation and the Sequoia Humane Society.
Even though we are house bound right now we are still trying to be good neighbors.
